# Asset credits

- **Vehicle, proving ground, UI, procedural surface textures, synthesized audio:** original project assets, inspired by the October 2026 Tesla Roadster reveal. This model is an artistic interpretation; no Tesla CAD or production specifications are bundled.
- **Sky HDRI:** “Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky),” Greg Zaal (original) and Jarod Guest (sky edits), Poly Haven. CC0 1.0. https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky — https://polyhaven.com/license — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  Local asset: `assets/sky.hdr`, the 1K Radiance HDR download.
- **Three.js r170 and RGBELoader:** Three.js Authors, MIT; see THREE-LICENSE.txt. RGBELoader's import is rewritten to the local vendored Three.js module. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r170/examples/jsm/loaders/RGBELoader.js
- **Barlow Condensed / DM Sans:** bundled fonts retain the SIL Open Font License in FONTS-OFL-1.1.txt.

Official reference imagery was used to guide modeling but is not redistributed in this game. No third-party car mesh is bundled.
